author: GI_Jose
body:
Your Minecraft Username: GI_Jose360
Time Zone: Eastern Standard Time   
Experiences:  I have been Admin/Moderator on other games Like War Commander on FB and Rush Team but that was a while ago I stepped down because I was not as active. I’ve been captain of patrols back in 6th grade if that’s of any relevance. I am now Captain of my AVID class which is a rigorous course that helps toward collage which requires a massive amount of responsibility and also time but it’s mostly school time. I am also a coach for my sister’s pewee soccer team.  Again, if that’s of any relevance.
 Why do you believe you should be a moderator for Avicus?:  Well, I have am always active and try to play as fairly as possible. I already know much of the staff and players through TeamSpeak so that’s a plus. Although I haven’t been playing for so long I know almost all the rules and regulations of the game. A downside is that I am not that active on the forums but I will work on that so we can get the greatest satisfaction from the rest of the players. I am now trying to read through the forums to get the vibe of the players. I am up for the task of jr.mod well I at least I’m sure but you all will have to decide for yourselves.  
How would you benefit the Avicus staff team?: As I am very active so I will be on reports like white on rice. I will make sure that the reports are well observed and dealt with accordingly. I will also try to more active on the forums and see what the players’ vibe on the server and issues with it so I can try to solve the ones that I can deal with and report the problems that I can’t to higher staff members. For instance if there’s a hacker I wouldn’t kick him I would try to get a moderator or higher to temp-ban or ban the player but if there is no moderator on I would record it or take screen shots for future reference.
If a player is using a hacked client on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?:  It would depend on which hacked client it is like Click-Bot or Aim-Bot for example it would most likely be a ban but I would check his/her infractions before proceeding. If it was a first offence I would most likely do a Temp-ban but I would talk with other staff members to see how long the time would be just to give the player a chance to change if it was a onetime thing. But most likely it would be a ban since we want out players to have a fair gaming experience and to enjoy themselves as much as possible.  
  If a player is swearing and being abusive on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?: I would give him a warning to stop with the swearing or being abusive remarks if he does not or I get future reports on it I will kick him for swearing.  If he/she continues I will request for temp ban and if he continues after that for a perma-ban because we want a positive environment. I personally do not like when people are being abusive because it reflects everyone else. I get people mess around with each other as I do with many of the players on TeamSpeak and mods that I know but never with anyone that I don’t because they might take what I say to heart and that’s something no one wants.
If a player is team griefing or team spleefing on the server what in your opinion would be the most appropriate punishment?:  If it’s a first offence or not as big of a situation I would most likely kick the user. But if he has multiple infractions or it’s a major problem I would temp ban him for a week or so. Personally I hate when people do that but I am not going to lie when I say I have done it myself. I did it before but to friends and I was glad to see that mods don’t pick favorites because they didn’t hesitate to kick me. But I would personally give the player a warning and if he/she will be handled accordingly  
 Do you have the ability to record video? I have the ability but would need proper software and some help on uploading the video. But otherwise I am able to do so.
Do you own a microphone and have access to TeamSpeak 3 and Skype?: Yes, I do I am active on TeamSpeak and on Skype so that would not be an issue.  
Is there anything else that will benefit your application?: Well to be honest this is my second time applying for staff on this server or any Minecraft -server I enjoy this server and I hope I get Jr. Mod but if I don’t I hope the most qualified people do.
